page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with a running head at the top right and the page number 49 beside it. Below the text, a centred title block for the next work: a heading, an italic subtitle, and a second heading. Then the opening paragraph of the new work with a large initial Q. At the foot, a gathering signature "D" centred and a catchword "ut" at the right. No marginal notes. Show-through and the edge of the neighbouring page on the left are not transcribed.

main_text.p: nè fufeque ad Imperatorem retulit, fine tamen rei non bono. Dixit enim Georgius Chosroen hæc regi dicere, Rex Perfarum ad fubditos proloquu-tus eft, ob legati virtutem bellum non moueo.quæ cum Imperator audiiffet, irafcitur legato, & Geor-gio admodum periculosè legatio illa fucceffit.

QUOD Phocas Lilium electum tyrannicæ pro-clamationis nuncium, cum muneribus regiis ad Chosroen ablegauit. unde Chosroes à tyrannide præsumpto belli argumento mundi illam universalem pernicem clanxit tubam, quæ utrinq; fregit & Romanorum & Persarum fortunas. ita quidem, prætexente Chosroe se Mauricij memoriæ asserturum exsequias & iusta, Persicum bellum est exortum. Lilius verò satis asperè tractatus apud Persas remansit.
main_text.head: DE LEGATIS GENTIVM AD ROMANOS.
THEOPHYLACTI EX PRÆFE-CTI ET SCRIPTURARII
main_text.p: QUOD Philippici generi Mauricij ductu ex re-gia urbe protectus Amidam venit. Legatione mittunt Persæ ut certis quippe conditionibus deponeretur bellum: petierunt namque à Romanis,

page.notes: No marginal notes on this page. The left edge of the scan shows show-through and the neighbouring page's text, which is not transcribed. The bottom centre mark "D" is read as the gathering signature and "ut" at the right as the catchword. The printed word "moueo.quæ" has no space after the full stop; kept as printed.
